out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Hand washing sign was not posted at the hand sink behind the kitchen door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EHS PROVIDED PIC WITH HAND WASHING SIGNS. POSTS SIGNS TO REMIND STAFF TO WASH HANDS OFTEN.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, Clean after Use
violations.observation: Observed the blade of the can opener with an accumulation of dark debris. Upon discussion with PIC, can opener was last used four days ago.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be cleaned at any time during the operation when contamination may have occurred. PIC BROUGHT THE CAN OPENER TO THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK TO BE WASHED, RINSED AND SANITIZED. CLEAN AND SANITIZE THE CAN OPENER AFTER EVERY USE.

violations.title: Equipment Clean to Sight and Touch
violations.observation: Handles of all coolers were observed with an accumulation of grease and other food debris
violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CLEAN COOLERS HANDS MORE FREQUENTLY. CORRECT BY THE NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. CFM WAS NOT PRESENT AT THE TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CFM ARRIVED BEFORE THE END OF THE INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at the handwashing sink but the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC REPLACED THE SOAP.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the hand sink by the 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLACED PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ranch made in facility 46F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED RANCH.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE DRINKING OUT OF AN OPEN CONTAINER IN THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. EHS EXPLAINED THAT OPEN DRINKING CONTAINERS ARE NOT ALLOWED IN THE KITCHEN AND HAD EMPLOYEE PUT A LID ON THE CUP.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken stored over raw onion in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EMPLOYEE MOVED THE ONIONS TO A DIFFERENT SHELF.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: cheese sauce 129F, and Mac and cheese 133F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EMPLOYEE DISCARDED FOOD.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: ranch 45-51F and crimson sauce (mayo and tomato sauce) 45F in the 2 dr prep top.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.
